text:
I decided to try my luck with the 30-baht universal healthcare scheme for teeth cleaning, believing it would be similar to paying out of pocket.

I found the dentist was very rushed. Before starting, they only asked if I was using the 30-baht scheme, then proceeded immediately. It was quite painful. At the end, they used a grinding tool on the tooth surface. They didn't even finish all the teeth; they were in a hurry.

The place was clean, and the staff at the counter were nice.

text: My first experience wasn't good. I went for a teeth cleaning and had messaged them beforehand to book an appointment, but the staff replied that I didn't need to book in advance and could just come in. In the end, I arrived at 5 PM and got a slot close to closing time because people who had booked appointments were arriving continuously. They could have just been honest and said the schedule was full so I could come another day. The dental service itself was good, though. The only issue was the staff's response to the message. It wasn't that they were rude; simply stating that the schedule was full would have been enough. I wasted so much time waiting until the clinic closed before receiving service – probably around 3 hours.
